# Kombu

Last updated: 2026-09-26

> Kombu is a one-person creative studio in Southampton run by Ryan Stanikk: web design, graphic design, commercial photography and marketing, plus the practical infrastructure that ties a business together. The defining trait is an engineering mind paired with a designer's eye. Clients get a single trusted route instead of three or four separate specialists.

Kombu (https://kombu.uk) is named after kombu kelp, a metaphor for being the quiet foundation beneath a great brand. It is a creative and marketing studio - not a food, seaweed or sushi product. Slogan: "One mind, the whole stack."

## What Kombu does
- Web design & development: bespoke, mobile-first, SEO-ready websites and web apps (https://kombu.uk/web-design/)
- Graphic design & branding: logos, brand identity, menus, packaging, print and editorial (https://kombu.uk/design/)
- Commercial photography: food and drink, interiors, product and brand imagery, with an instant quote calculator (https://kombu.uk/photography/)
- Marketing: strategy, paid ads, social, local SEO, and the Hospitality Health Check diagnostic (https://kombu.uk/marketing/)
- Infrastructure & problem-solving: sourcing suppliers, connecting software systems, and building bespoke tools that don't exist yet

## Who runs it
Ryan Stanikk: a Southampton designer, photographer and web developer with two decades of graphic design experience (since age 17) and fifteen years behind the camera. Operates as a one-person cross-disciplinary studio, holding the photography, design, website, brand and marketing for a client in one head so everything stays consistent. (https://kombu.uk/about/)

## Location and area served
- Based in Southampton, Hampshire, England
- Serves Southampton, Eastleigh, Winchester, Portsmouth, Fareham, Romsey, Chandler's Ford, Hedge End and Totton
- Works remotely with clients anywhere in the United Kingdom

## Pricing
- Web design: Starter GBP 49/month or GBP 229 to build; Business GBP 99/month or GBP 499; Professional GBP 175/month or GBP 899. Bespoke sites quoted from GBP 1,500, web apps from GBP 1,200. Hosting, SSL, domain and support included. After the 12-month term, plans continue at GBP 29/49/99 per month respectively.
- Graphic design: quoted per project, get in touch with what you need.
- Photography: priced live via the quote calculator; standard sessions GBP 275 (2h), GBP 415 (half day), GBP 690 (full day), Local independents, charities and individuals within ~30 miles of Southampton pay GBP 220/330/550 (20% off); national rate GBP 385/580/965; worldwide usage quoted individually. Standard rates within ~25 miles, then a distance rate (x1.15 to 80 miles, x1.25 to 150, x1.40 beyond); London GBP 581 half day / GBP 966 full day. eCommerce: up to 15 products a half day, 16 to 40 a full day, over 40 quoted per image. Video: GBP 495 (2h), GBP 795 (half day), GBP 1,295 (full day), one rate for every business plus the distance rate, booked separately from photo shoots. Travel and accommodation are added at cost.
- Marketing: Hospitality Health Check from GBP 295; ongoing studio partnership retainer from GBP 950/month.

## Selected clients
Soleto, Padharo, Banana Wharf, The Grand, Kesarum, Ryan Stanikk Photography, Ark Angels, Ennios, Grumpy Monkey, Mustang Group, Kwackers, Ideal Produce, Build Budget Expert, Remedi Health

## Own products
- msnry (https://msnry.app): Ryan's own browser app that lays a handful of photos out as one seamless Instagram carousel, with no account and nothing uploaded.

## Case studies
- Padharo (vegetarian Indian restaurant, 100-102 East Street, Southampton): Ryan designed and built the website, photographs the restaurant, shot the film on its home page, designs every menu (main, drinks, Diwali, Christmas, kids) and runs its Instagram, Facebook and emails. (https://kombu.uk/work/padharo/)
- Mustang Group (family-run Southampton hospitality group, six venues, established 1987): since May 2026 Ryan has looked after the group's websites, rebuilt the Banana Wharf, Grumpy Monkey and Ennio's sites, built a new phone-first group site (in preview) and has photographed four of the venues (The Grand, Ennio's, Banana Wharf and Grumpy Monkey); every Monday the group gets a report on the Banana Wharf and Ennio's sites. On real phones Banana Wharf's pages now show their main content in about 1 second, down from about 3.7 seconds on the old WordPress site (Google's Chrome UX Report data from real visitors, phones, 75th percentile). (https://kombu.uk/work/mustang-group/)
- Each case study opens with a short film of the work, cut to music.
- All case studies: https://kombu.uk/work/

## Why choose Kombu
- One trusted route: photography, design, web and marketing from one person, with no handoffs and no specialist markup
- Everything matches: the brand, the photos, the site and the marketing pull in the same direction
- Builds the missing piece rather than handing you off to expensive specialists
- Direct, personal service: you talk to the person doing the work; everyday changes included, no lock-in
